mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties; concurrent use causes additive anticholinergic effects leading to increased risk of urinary retention, constipation, cognitive impairment, and tachycardia.
action: Avoid concomitant use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for anticholinergic toxicity including urinary symptoms, mental status changes, and cardiac effects; consider alternative agents with lower anticholinergic burden.
